(297)༄༅/ /bka' babs drug ldan gyi zab khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (297)༄༅// bka' babs drug ldan gyi zab khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(298)༄༅// na mo gu ru badz+ra dha rā ya/ bka' babs drug ldan gyi khrid kyi thog mar bskyed rim gyi brgyud 'debs ni/ khyab bdag yon tan brgyad ldan rdo rje 'chang*// 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rjes bzung ye shes zhabs// mthong chos zhir gshegs mar me mdzad bzang po// hūm̐ mdzad ngo bor grub pa sman pa'i zhabs// sangs rgyas dpal zhi'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// sangs rgyas ye shes pad 'byung bde ba can// rin tshul yig mkhan bgres po dur ha ri// sman zhabs a ba dhū ti shān+ti pa// chu bo gsum 'dus rdo rje gdan pa che// rin 'byung sbas pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs// dge 'byung sbas pa stobs bcu badz+ra shrī// chos dpal bzang po sangs rgyas rin chen grags// rā ti gup+ta rnams la= /dpal ldan sems can mgon po zhi ba sbas// grub chen dī na ka ra zab mo'i blo// gsum kas rjes bzung sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon// gang ba'i rdo rje myang 'das dpal ba ste// thugs sras rnam gsum bka' babs gdams pa'i klung*// gcig bsdus gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon po'i zhabs// rin chen rgya mtsho blo gros rnam par rgyal// ngag dbang phrin las chos rje kun bzang dbang*// kun dga' rnam rgyal ngag dbang rgyal ba'i mtshan// grub chen dri med 'od gsal 'gyur med mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= /bsnyen pa gsum gyis rang rgyud byin rlabs shing*// rnal 'byor gnyis kyi gsal snang mtha' ru phyin// zhu bde stong nyid zab mo'i rgyas thabs nas// bskyed rim mtha' ru phyin par byin gyi rlobs// ༈ /gnyis pa phyag chen brgyud 'debs ni/(299) /srid zhi kun khyab drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// rgyud dang grub pa'i sgo 'byed sa ra ha// sangs rgyas gnyis pa klu sgrub sha ba ri// lu yi dā ri ka dang ḍeṃ gi pa// an+tar te lo nā ro ḍom+bhi pa/ ku sa li pa a si ta gha na// ye shes bshes gnyen rnams la gsol=

/ri khrod dbang phyug mda' bdag me tri pa// gaṅgā dha ri dzñā na mi tra dang*// ye shes sku mnyes grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs// slob ma'i mchog gnyis thugs sras rnam pa gsum// kun dga' snying po rgyal tshab rin rgyam zhabs// blo gros rnam rgyal ngag dbang phrin las dang*// kun bzang dbang po kun dga' rnam par rgyal// ngag dbang rgyal mtshan grub chen dri med mtshan// 'od gsal 'gyur med rtsa ba'i bla ma ste// khyab bdag brgyud par bcas la= /dmigs bcas dmigs med sems gnas mthar thug 'grub// ngo sprod brgyad pas ci snang sgom du gyur// gegs gsum sel zhing bogs gsum thon nas kyang*// gnas lugs phyag chen rtogs par byin gyi rlobs// ༈ /gsum pa gtum mo'i brgyud 'debs ni/ /rdo rje btsun mo tsaṇ+ḍa rgyal ba'i yum// mthu stobs dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong zhabs// nag po bi ru pa dang bya rngon pa// ku sa li pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bi rū ḍom+bi g.yung mo rnal 'byor ma// ra ta badz+ra spyod 'chang dbang po'i zhabs// siṅga li ma mi thub zla ba dang*// sgra gcan 'dzin pa'i rdo rje dā na shrī// so so rig pa dang ku sa li bha dra// a si ta mtshan ye shes bshes gnyen dang*// gtum mos rnam smin lus sbyangs zhi ba'i zhabs// dge tshul rnal 'byor ma dpal rgya gar ba// rnam (300)gsum bcud 'dus kun snying he ru ka /rin rgyam blo gros ngag dbang kun bzang mtshan// kun rnam ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dri ma med// 'od gsal 'gyur med drin can bla ma'i zhabs// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ rnal 'byor mthu yis rtsa ba'i lam 'byongs shing*// byin gyis brlab thob rlung bzhi gtum mo bzhi// thig le gsum dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa gnyis// mthar phyin mchog gi gtum mo 'grub gyur cig/ ༈ /bzhi pa 'od gsal gyi brgyud 'debs ni/ /mtha' yas ye shes spyi gzugs rdo rje 'chang*// 'od gsal bsam mi khyab brnyis rta mchog zhabs// bī na sa dang tsin+to rnal 'byor ma// rdo rje dril bu pa dang lwa ba pa// in+d+ra bhū ti grub chen byis pa'i zhabs// nag po spyod pa gu h+ya an+tar pa// te lo nā ro dpal mchog ḍom+bi pa// ku sa li pa rnams la gsol=

/ān+tar pa dang spyod chung bhu ha ri// bhu ba blo ldan ku sa li bha dra// a si ta gha ye shes bshes pa'i gnyen// 'od gsal mkha' khyab shwan+ti gup+ta dang*// zab blo di nā ka ra thugs sras gsum// chu bo kun 'dus rje btsun thams cad mkhyen// rgyal tshab rat+na blo gros ngag dbang mtshan// kun bzang dbang po kun dga' rnam par rgyal// ngag dbang dri med 'od gsal 'gyur ba med// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam rjes sad rmi bar do sgyu mar rtogs// sku gsung thugs dang ye shes gong du 'pho// nyin mtshan 'od gsal ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gis// sku bzhi'i ye shes 'grub par byin gyi rlobs// ༈ /lnga pa las rgya'i khrid kyi brgyud 'debs ni// kha sbyor bdun ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// in+d+ra bhū ti bde ba'i rol pa mo// pad+ma badz+ra dpal ldan phag tshad pa// mtsho skyes zhabs dang in+d+ra bhū ti'i mtshan// dza lan+dha ri grub chen ka hā pa// dag pa'i (301)mgon po a mi ta badz+ra// ku sa li pa rnams la= /dbang po'i 'byor pa pad+mā ka ri'i zhabs// gdams pa'i mnga' bdag ku sa li che chung*// a si ta dang dzñā na mi tra dang*// bde chen rdo rje'i skur bzhengs zhi ba sbas// mchog gnyis sras gsum sgrol mgon rdo rje 'chang*// rin rgyam blo gros ngag phrin kun bzang dbang*// kun rgyal ngag dbang dri med 'od gsal mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dbang thob sgrib dag tshogs rdzogs 'dren 'byongs nas// srog thur mnyam 'dres gegs sel bogs thon cing*// ye shes las rgyar dbab bzung zlog dgram la// dbang 'byor bde chen rdo rje'i sku thob shog/ ༈ /drug pa man ngag thor bu'i brgyud 'debs ni/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gi grub brnyes tsa rapa ṭi pa dang*// bcud len dngos grub thob pa byā li pa// kuk+ku ṭi pa slob dpon ma tshin+d+ra// grub pa bye ba'i 'byung gnas gau rak+ṣa// kā ṇa ri pa nā go rdza ma'i mgon// o kor nā tha rā ti gup+ta dang*// tshig don gsang ba kun bdag zhi ba'i zhabs// slob ma'i mchog gnyis thugs sras rnam pa gsum// 'jigs bral shing rta chen po kun dga' snying*// rin rgyam blo gros phrin las kun bzang dbang*// rnam rgyal ngag dbang dri med 'od gsal mtshan// drin can bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// yi dam bla sgrub mthar phyin bar chad sel// sems 'dzin dbang 'byor rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs// rab gsal ting nge 'dzin la bogs thon te// yon tan gong du 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs/

/zhes brgyud 'debs kyi phreng ba 'di rnams kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su gnang ba ltar/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos bla brang dben pa zla mdzes su bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /(302)
